notes: 疑似不等于全部已证错误，不据此把整套自动重生成。
不同机位/透视/反射不能作为量化曲率或厚度测量。
旧62条QA与旧打包保留历史；技术导出完整不代表造型已确认。
recommended_method: Use existing/new video to extract clear front/back/left/right side frames; first align real silhouette and shape landmarks.
Prefer photographed product cutout compositing with separately created background/people/water; preserve real product geometry instead of repeatedly redrawing the whole product.
Use manufacturer CAD/3D source if already available; shiny silver video alone is not a guarantee of accurate automatic reconstruction.
